thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine: A teal stone that slowly shifts color, found in ocean monuments. Craft four prismarine shards into one. It has stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_bri: Neat teal bricks from ocean monuments. Craft nine prismarine shards into one block. They have stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_prismarin: A dark teal stone from ocean monuments. Craft eight prismarine shards around black dye. It has stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_sta: Stairs made of prismarine. Craft six prismarine in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. Their color slowly shifts like the original block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_bri: Stairs made of prismarine bricks. Craft six bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit ocean-themed builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_prismarin: Stairs made of dark prismarine. Craft six blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit deep ocean builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sea_lantern: A glowing block found in ocean monuments and ruins. It gives off full light, even under water. Craft it from prismarine shards and crystals; without Silk Touch it drops crystals.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_sandstone: Sandstone made from red sand, found under badlands. Craft four red sand into one. It can be cut, chiseled or smoothed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_red_s: Red sandstone carved with a wither-like pattern. Craft two red sandstone slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piston: A block that pushes up to twelve blocks when powered. It can't push obsidian, bedrock or blocks with containers. Add a slimeball to make a sticky piston.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sticky_piston: A piston with a slimeball on its face. It pushes blocks when powered and pulls them back when unpowered. It is the heart of most hidden doors.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.slime_block: A bouncy green block made from nine slimeballs. You bounce off it instead of taking fall damage. Moved by a piston, it drags neighbouring blocks along.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.honey_block: A sticky block made from four honey bottles. It slows you down, stops you jumping and lets you slide slowly down its sides. Pistons can use it to move blocks, but it won't stick to slime.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.observer: A redstone component that watches the block in front of it. When that block changes, it sends a short pulse out of its back. It powers many crop farms.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hopper: A funnel made from five iron ingots and a chest. It pulls items from above and pushes them into the container it points at. A redstone signal locks it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dispenser: A block that uses or fires items when powered. It shoots arrows and fire charges, places water and lava, and equips armor on players in front of it. Craft it from cobblestone, a bow and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dropper: A block that drops an item out of its face when powered. Pointed into a container, it moves items instead. Craft it from seven cobblestone and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lectern: A reading stand that holds a book and quill or a written book, so several players can read it. It is the job site of librarians. A comparator reads which page is open.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.target: A block that sends a redstone signal when hit by a projectile; the closer to the centre, the stronger. Craft it from a hay bale and four redstone dust. It is great for archery games and switches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lever: A switch that stays on or off when flipped. Craft it from a stick and cobblestone. It is the simplest way to power redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lightning_rod: A copper rod that attracts lightning strikes nearby, protecting flammable builds. It gives off a redstone signal when struck. Craft it from three copper ingots.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.daylight_detec: A sensor that outputs redstone power based on sunlight. Right-click it to invert it into a night detector. Craft it from glass, nether quartz and wooden slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk_sensor: A sculk block that detects vibrations like footsteps and doors within eight blocks and gives off a redstone signal. Wool blocks and sneaking keep you hidden from it. It is found in the deep dark.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.calibrated_scu: A sculk sensor tuned with amethyst shards. A redstone signal on its side makes it listen only for one kind of vibration. It also hears a little further than a normal sensor.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tripwire_hook: A hook that, with string stretched between two of them, makes a tripwire. Walking through the string sends a redstone signal. Craft it from an iron ingot, a stick and planks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trapped_chest: A chest that gives off a redstone signal when opened. The more players look inside, the stronger the signal. Craft it from a chest and a tripwire hook.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tnt: An explosive block made from five gunpowder and four sand. Light it with flint and steel, fire or redstone, then stand back. It destroys most blocks around it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.redstone_lamp: A lamp that lights up only while powered by redstone. Craft it from four redstone dust around glowstone. It gives full light when on.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.note_block: A block that plays a note when hit or powered. Right-click to change the pitch; the block underneath changes the instrument. Craft it from eight planks and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_button: A stone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one stone. Unlike wooden buttons, arrows can't press it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: A blackstone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one polished blackstone. Arrows can't press it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one oak plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one spruce plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one birch plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one jungle plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one acacia plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one cherry plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_butto: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one dark oak plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_butto: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one mangrove plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one bamboo plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one crimson plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one warped plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_pressure: A stone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two stone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: A blackstone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two polished blackstone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_weighted: A gold pressure plate that gives a stronger signal the more things stand on it. Craft it from two gold ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.heavy_weighted: An iron pressure plate that measures weight, needing many more things for a strong signal. Craft it from two iron ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_pressure_p: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two oak planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two spruce planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_pressure: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two birch planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two jungle planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two acacia planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two cherry planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_press: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two dark oak planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_press: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two mangrove planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two bamboo planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_pressu: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two crimson planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two warped planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_door: A sturdy door that only redstone can open, such as a button or lever. Craft six iron ingots into three doors. Zombies can't break it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six oak planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six spruce planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six birch planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six jungle planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six acacia planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six cherry planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six dark oak planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six mangrove planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six bamboo planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six crimson planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six warped planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_door: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_copper: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It has started to oxidize and will keep aging unless waxed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_copp: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_coppe: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_copper_d: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax at the first stage of oxidation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its mostly green stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its fully teal stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_trapdoor: An iron hatch that only redstone can open. Craft it from four iron ingots. It makes secure floor and wall hatches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_trapdoor: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six oak planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_trapdoo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six spruce planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_trapdoor: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six birch planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_trapdoo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six jungle planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_trapdoo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six acacia planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_trapdoo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six cherry planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_trapd: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six dark oak planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_trapd: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six mangrove planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_trapdo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six crimson planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_trapdoo: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six warped planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_trapdoo: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_copper: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It has started to oxidize and will keep aging unless waxed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_copp: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_coppe: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_copper_t: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax at the first stage of oxidation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its mostly green stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: A copper hatch made from four copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its fully teal stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_fence_gate: A gate for oak fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two oak planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_fence_g: A gate for spruce fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two spruce planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_fence_ga: A gate for birch fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two birch planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_fence_g: A gate for jungle fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two jungle planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_fence_g: A gate for acacia fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two acacia planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_fence_g: A gate for cherry fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two cherry planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_fence: A gate for dark oak fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two dark oak planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_fence: A gate for mangrove fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two mangrove planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_fence_g: A gate for bamboo fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two bamboo planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_fence_: A gate for crimson fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two crimson planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_fence_g: A gate for warped fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two warped planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.powered_rail: A rail that speeds minecarts up when powered and brakes them when not. Craft gold ingots, a stick and redstone into six. Place one every so often to keep carts moving.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.detector_rail: A rail that gives off a redstone signal while a minecart is on it. Craft it from iron ingots, a stone pressure plate and redstone. Use it to trigger stations and switches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rail: The basic track for minecarts. Craft six iron ingots and a stick into sixteen. Rails curve automatically to connect to each other.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.activator_rail: A rail that triggers special minecarts when powered. It ignites TNT minecarts, toggles hopper minecarts and throws riders off. Craft it from iron, sticks and a redstone torch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.saddle: Gear for riding horses, donkeys, mules, pigs and striders. It can't be crafted; find it in chests, while fishing or from leatherworkers. Pigs and striders also need a lure on a stick to steer.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.minecart: A cart that rides along rails. Craft it from five iron ingots. Players and mobs can ride in it, and it can be combined with a chest, furnace, hopper or TNT.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chest_minecart: A minecart carrying a chest with 27 slots. Craft it from a minecart and a chest. Hoppers can load and unload it, making it perfect for item transport.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.furnace_mineca: A minecart with a furnace that pushes itself and other carts. Give it coal or charcoal to start it moving. It is the only self-powered minecart.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tnt_minecart: A minecart loaded with TNT. It explodes when it passes over a powered activator rail or crashes from a height. Craft it from a minecart and TNT.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hopper_minecar: A minecart with a hopper that collects items along the track and from containers above. Craft it from a minecart and a hopper. Pair it with a hopper below the rails to unload it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.carrot_on_a_st: A fishing rod with a carrot tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled pig to steer it. Each boost wears it down a little.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_fungus_: A fishing rod with a warped fungus tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled strider to steer it across lava. Each boost wears it down a little.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.elytra: Wings found on End ships, worn in the chestplate slot. Jump while falling to glide, and use firework rockets to fly. Repair it with phantom membranes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_boat: A oak boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five oak planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_chest_boat: A oak boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a oak boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_boat: A spruce boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five spruce planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_chest_b: A spruce boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a spruce boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_boat: A birch boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five birch planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_chest_bo: A birch boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a birch boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_boat: A jungle boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five jungle planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_chest_b: A jungle boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a jungle boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_boat: A acacia boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five acacia planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_chest_b: A acacia boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a acacia boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_boat: A cherry boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five cherry planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_chest_b: A cherry boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a cherry boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_boat: A dark oak boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five dark oak planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_chest: A dark oak boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a dark oak boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_boat: A mangrove boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five mangrove planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_chest: A mangrove boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a mangrove boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_raft: A flat raft made from bamboo, working just like a boat. Craft it from five bamboo planks. It carries two passengers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_chest_r: A bamboo raft with a chest on board. Craft it from a bamboo raft and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.structure_bloc: A block for saving and loading structures, used by map makers. It can copy a build and paste it elsewhere. It can only be obtained with commands.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jigsaw: A block that joins pieces of structures together during world generation. Map makers use it to build villages and dungeons from parts. It can only be obtained with commands.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.turtle_helmet: A helmet made from five turtle scutes. Wearing it gives a short water breathing effect whenever you dive. It is also brewed into potions of the turtle master.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.turtle_scute: A shell piece dropped by a baby turtle when it grows up. Five craft into a turtle shell. It also repairs turtle shells.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.armadillo_scut: A scale that armadillos shed over time; brush one to collect it right away. Six scutes craft into wolf armor. It also repairs wolf armor.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wolf_armor: Armor for tamed wolves, crafted from six armadillo scutes. It absorbs damage until it breaks, protecting your dog. You can dye it any color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flint_and_stee: A lighter made from an iron ingot and flint. Use it to start fires, light TNT and campfires, or open a Nether portal. Each use wears it down.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bowl: A simple wooden bowl crafted from three planks. It holds stews and soups. You get the bowl back after eating.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.apple: A fruit dropped by oak and dark oak leaves. Eat it for a little food. Combine it with gold for a golden apple.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bow: A ranged weapon that fires arrows; draw it longer for stronger shots. Craft it from three sticks and three string. It can be enchanted with Power, Flame and Infinity.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.arrow: Ammunition for bows, crossbows and dispensers. Craft flint, a stick and a feather into four arrows. Skeletons drop them, and tipped versions carry potion effects.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.coal: The most common fuel, mined from coal ore. One piece smelts eight items. Combine it with a stick for torches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.charcoal: Fuel made by smelting logs or wood. It works exactly like coal in furnaces and torch recipes. It can't be crafted into a coal block, though.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond: A precious gem mined deep underground. It makes the best tools and armor before netherite, plus enchanting tables and jukeboxes. Nine craft into a block of diamond.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.emerald: A green gem used as currency with villagers. Mine it from emerald ore in mountains, or earn it by trading. Nine craft into a block of emerald.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lapis_lazuli: A blue gem mined from lapis ore. It is spent at the enchanting table and also works as blue dye. Nine craft into a lapis block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.quartz: A white crystal mined in the Nether. It makes quartz blocks, comparators, observers and daylight detectors. Mining it gives plenty of experience.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.amethyst_shard: A purple crystal shard from amethyst clusters. It makes spyglasses, tinted glass and calibrated sculk sensors. Allays duplicate when given one while dancing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_iron: Unrefined iron dropped by iron ore. Smelt it into an iron ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw iron.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_ingot: A bar of iron from smelting raw iron. It is one of the most useful materials, needed for tools, armor, buckets, rails and more. Nine pack into a block of iron.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_copper: Unrefined copper dropped by copper ore. Smelt it into a copper ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw copper.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_ingot: A bar of copper from smelting raw copper. It makes copper blocks, lightning rods, spyglasses and brushes. Nine pack into a copper block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.raw_gold: Unrefined gold dropped by gold ore. Smelt it into a gold ingot. Nine pack into a block of raw gold.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gold_ingot: A bar of gold from smelting raw gold. It makes golden tools, clocks, powered rails and golden food. Piglins trade items for it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_ingo: The toughest metal, made from four netherite scrap and four gold ingots. Use it at a smithing table to upgrade diamond gear to netherite. Like everything netherite, it survives lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_scra: A fragment from smelting ancient debris. Four scrap and four gold ingots craft into a netherite ingot. It doesn't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wooden_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two planks and a stick. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wooden_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one plank and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wooden_pickaxe: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wooden_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wooden_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two planks and two sticks. Wooden tools are the weakest and wear out quickly, but they burn as fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_sword: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Craft it from two cobblestone and a stick. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one cobblestone and two sticks. Stone tools are a cheap step up from wood; blackstone or cobbled deepslate work as well.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_shovel: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Craft it from one diamond and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_pickax: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Craft it from three diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Craft it from three diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Craft it from two diamonds and two sticks. Diamond tools are fast and long-lasting, second only to netherite.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_swor: A melee weapon; its sweeping attack hits several enemies, and it cuts through cobwebs quickly. Upgrade a diamond sword at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_shov: It digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow quickly, and turns grass into dirt paths. Upgrade a diamond shovel at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_pick: It mines stone and ores; the material decides which ores it can collect. Upgrade a diamond pickaxe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_axe: It chops wood, strips logs and scrapes copper; a hit with it can disable a shield. Upgrade a diamond axe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_hoe: It tills dirt into farmland and quickly breaks leaves, hay and sculk. Upgrade a diamond hoe at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite tools are the strongest, last the longest and don't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stick: The most basic crafting part, made from two planks into four sticks. It is the handle of tools, torches and many other items. Dead bushes and leaves sometimes drop them too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mushroom_stew: A bowl of stew made from a red and a brown mushroom. Eating it fills you up well, and you keep the bowl. Milking a mooshroom with a bowl gives it too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.string: Thread dropped by spiders and found in cobwebs. It makes bows, fishing rods, wool and scaffolding. Placed between tripwire hooks, it becomes a tripwire.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.feather: A feather dropped by chickens. It is needed for arrows and the book and quill. It also makes the brush.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gunpowder: A grey powder dropped by creepers, ghasts and witches. It makes TNT, fire charges and firework rockets. It turns potions into splash potions.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wheat_seeds: Seeds from breaking grass, or from harvesting wheat. Plant them on farmland to grow wheat. Chickens love them and follow you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wheat: A grain harvested from fully grown wheat crops. Three make bread, and it goes into cake and cookies. Cows, sheep and goats breed with it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bread: A loaf baked from three wheat. It is a simple, filling food. Villager farmers often trade it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather_chestp: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather_leggin: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four leather. Leather armor is the weakest, but it can be dyed any color and stops powder snow from freezing you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chainmail_helm: Armor for your head. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chainmail_ches: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chainmail_legg: Armor for your legs. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chainmail_boot: Armor for your feet. It can't be crafted; buy it from armorers or take it from mobs that wear it. Chainmail sits between leather and iron in protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_chestplat: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_leggings: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four iron ingots. Iron armor is solid mid-tier protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_chestp: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_leggin: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four diamonds. Diamond armor gives strong protection and adds toughness against heavy hits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_helmet: Armor for your head. Craft it from five gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_chestpl: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Craft it from eight gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_legging: Armor for your legs. Craft it from seven gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_boots: Armor for your feet. Craft it from four gold ingots. Gold armor is weak but enchants well, and piglins won't attack you while you wear any of it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_helm: Armor for your head. Upgrade diamond helmet at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_ches: Armor for your body, giving the most protection of the set. Upgrade diamond chestplate at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_legg: Armor for your legs. Upgrade diamond leggings at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.netherite_boot: Armor for your feet. Upgrade diamond boots at a smithing table with a netherite ingot and a smithing template. Netherite armor is the strongest, reduces knockback and doesn't burn in lava.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flint: A sharp stone sometimes dropped by gravel. It makes arrows and flint and steel. Fletchers buy it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.porkchop: Raw meat dropped by pigs and hoglins. Eating it raw gives little food. Cook it for a much better meal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_porkcho: A cooked porkchop, one of the most filling foods. Cook raw porkchop in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Pigs drop it already cooked if they die in fire.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.painting: A decoration made from eight sticks and wool. Place it on a wall to show a random painting that fits the space. It can be up to four by four blocks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_apple: An apple wrapped in eight gold ingots. Eating it gives regeneration and absorption. It also cures zombie villagers when combined with a splash potion of weakness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.enchanted_gold: A rare glowing apple found only in chests. Eating it gives strong regeneration, absorption, resistance and fire resistance. It can't be crafted.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_sign: A oak sign for short notes and labels. Craft six oak planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_sign: A spruce sign for short notes and labels. Craft six spruce planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_sign: A birch sign for short notes and labels. Craft six birch planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_sign: A jungle sign for short notes and labels. Craft six jungle planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_sign: A acacia sign for short notes and labels. Craft six acacia planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_sign: A cherry sign for short notes and labels. Craft six cherry planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_sign: A dark oak sign for short notes and labels. Craft six dark oak planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_sign: A mangrove sign for short notes and labels. Craft six mangrove planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_sign: A bamboo sign for short notes and labels. Craft six bamboo planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_sign: A crimson sign for short notes and labels. Craft six crimson planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_sign: A warped sign for short notes and labels. Craft six warped planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_hanging_si: A oak sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped oak logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_hanging: A spruce sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped spruce logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_hanging_: A birch sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped birch logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_hanging: A jungle sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped jungle logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_hanging: A acacia sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped acacia logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_hanging: A cherry sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped cherry logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_hangi: A dark oak sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped dark oak logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_hangi: A mangrove sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped mangrove logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_hanging: A bamboo sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped bamboo blocks and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_hangin: A crimson sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped crimson stems and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_hanging: A warped sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped warped stems and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides. It never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bucket: An iron bucket made from three iron ingots. It scoops up water, lava, powder snow and fish, and milks cows and goats. It is one of the most useful tools you can make.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.water_bucket: A bucket full of water. Pour it to place a water source; two sources side by side make an endless supply. A quick splash also saves you from fall damage and puts out fires.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lava_bucket: A bucket full of lava. As fuel it smelts a hundred items. Pour it carefully: lava burns almost everything it touches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.powder_snow_bu: A bucket of powder snow, collected from snowy slopes. Pour it to place powder snow, which mobs sink into and freeze. Leather boots let you walk on top of it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.snowball: A ball of snow made by digging snow with a shovel. Throw it to knock back mobs; it hurts blazes. Four craft into a snow block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather: Hide dropped by cows, horses, llamas, mooshrooms and hoglins. It makes leather armor, books, item frames and bundles. Rabbit hide also crafts into it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.milk_bucket: A bucket of milk from a cow, goat or mooshroom. Drinking it removes all status effects, good and bad. It is also needed for cake.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pufferfish_buc: A bucket holding a live pufferfish. Pour it out to release the fish somewhere else. Watch out: pufferfish puff up and poison anything nearby.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.salmon_bucket: A bucket holding a live salmon. Pour it out to release the fish into a new home. Use an empty water bucket on a salmon to catch one.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cod_bucket: A bucket holding a live cod. Pour it out to release the fish into a new home. Use a water bucket on a cod to catch one.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tropical_fish_: A bucket holding a live tropical fish, keeping its colors and pattern. Pour it out to release it into an aquarium. Use a water bucket on one to catch it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.axolotl_bucket: A bucket holding a live axolotl. Pour it out to release it; axolotls help you fight underwater mobs. Use a water bucket on one in a lush cave to catch it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tadpole_bucket: A bucket holding a live tadpole. Pour it out to release it; it grows into a frog whose color depends on the climate. Use a water bucket on one to catch it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brick: A small clay brick made by smelting a clay ball. Four craft into a brick block. Three make a flower pot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.clay_ball: A lump of clay from breaking a clay block. Smelt it into a brick. Four craft back into a clay block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dried_kelp_blo: Nine dried kelp packed into a block. As fuel it smelts twenty items. It is also a compostable decorative block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.paper: Sheets made from three sugar cane. It is used for books, maps and firework rockets. Librarians and cartographers trade for it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.book: A book made from three paper and a piece of leather. It makes bookshelves, enchanting tables and the book and quill. Enchant it to store an enchantment for later.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.slime_ball: A ball of slime dropped by slimes, also sneezed by panda cubs. It makes sticky pistons, leads, slime blocks and magma cream. Nine craft into a slime block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.egg: An egg laid by chickens. Throw it for a small chance to hatch a chick. It is used to bake cake and pumpkin pie.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.compass: A compass that points to the world spawn. Use it on a lodestone to point there instead. Craft it from four iron ingots around redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.recovery_compa: A compass that points to where you last died. Craft it from eight echo shards around a compass. It spins aimlessly if you haven't died in this dimension.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bundle: A small pouch that holds a stack's worth of mixed items in one slot. Craft it from rabbit hide and string. In this version it is an experimental item.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fishing_rod: A rod made from three sticks and two string. Cast it into water to catch fish and sometimes treasure. You can also hook mobs and pull them toward you.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.clock: A clock made from four gold ingots around redstone. It shows the position of the sun and moon. It doesn't work in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spyglass: A small telescope made from two copper ingots and an amethyst shard. Hold right-click to zoom in on faraway things. It is great for scouting.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glowstone_dust: Dust from breaking glowstone. It makes potions stronger, lights up spectral arrows and crafts back into glowstone. Four dust form one glowstone block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cod: A raw fish caught by fishing or from cod in oceans. Eat it for a little food, or cook it for more. Cats and ocelots love it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.salmon: A raw fish caught by fishing or from salmon in rivers and cold oceans. Eat it raw or cook it for more food. Cats and ocelots love it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tropical_fish: A colourful fish caught in warm oceans. It gives very little food. Axolotls are fed with buckets of tropical fish.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pufferfish: A spiky fish that poisons you if eaten, causing nausea and hunger. It is brewed into potions of water breathing. Live pufferfish puff up and sting anything that swims too close.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_cod: A cooked cod fillet. Cook raw cod in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is a decent, easy food.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_salmon: A cooked salmon fillet, more filling than cooked cod. Cook raw salmon in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is one of the better fish foods.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ink_sac: A sac of black ink dropped by squids. It works as black dye and makes the book and quill. Use it on a sign to make glowing text dark again.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glow_ink_sac: A glowing ink sac dropped by glow squids. Use it on a sign to make the text glow. It crafts glow item frames.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cocoa_beans: Beans that grow in pods on jungle logs. They make brown dye and cookies. Plant them on jungle logs to grow more.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_dye: A white dye made from bone meal or lilies of the valley. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_dye: A orange dye made from orange tulips, torchflowers, or red and yellow dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_dye: A magenta dye made from alliums, lilacs, or mixing purple and pink dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_dye: A light blue dye made from blue orchids, or blue and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_dye: A yellow dye made from dandelions or sunflowers. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_dye: A lime dye made from smelting sea pickles, or green and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_dye: A pink dye made from pink tulips, peonies, pink petals, or red and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_dye: A gray dye made from mixing black and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_dye: A light gray dye made from azure bluets, oxeye daisies, white tulips, or mixing dyes. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cyan_dye: A cyan dye made from pitcher plants, or blue and green dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purple_dye: A purple dye made from mixing blue and red dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_dye: A blue dye made from lapis lazuli or cornflowers. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_dye: A brown dye made from cocoa beans. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_dye: A green dye made from smelting cactus. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_dye: A red dye made from poppies, red tulips, rose bushes or beetroots. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.black_dye: A black dye made from ink sacs or wither roses. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bone_meal: A fertilizer made from bones or a composter. It makes crops, saplings and flowers grow instantly. It also works as white dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bone: A bone dropped by skeletons. It crafts into three bone meal. Feed it to a wolf to tame it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sugar: Sweet crystals made from sugar cane. It goes into cake, pumpkin pie and fermented spider eyes. It brews into potions of swiftness.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cake: A cake made from milk, sugar, an egg and wheat. Place it and eat it one slice at a time; it has seven slices. Put a candle on top for a birthday cake.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_bed: A white bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three white wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_bed: A orange bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three orange wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_bed: A magenta bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three magenta wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_bed: A light blue bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three light blue wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_bed: A yellow bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three yellow wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_bed: A lime bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three lime wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_bed: A pink bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three pink wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_bed: A gray bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three gray wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_bed: A light gray bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three light gray wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_bed: A green bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three green wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
