thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cookie: A small sweet made from two wheat and cocoa beans, eight at a time. It restores a little hunger. Never feed one to a parrot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crafter: A block that crafts automatically when powered by redstone. Lay out the recipe in its 3x3 grid and lock the slots you don't need. Craft it from iron, redstone, a crafting table and a dropper.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.filled_map: A map showing the area you have explored. Hold it to fill it in as you walk. Use a cartography table to zoom, copy or lock it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.shears: A tool made from two iron ingots. Shear sheep for wool and collect leaves, vines, cobwebs and grass. It also carves faces into pumpkins.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.melon_slice: A juicy slice of melon. It restores a little hunger. Nine craft into a whole melon, and one gives melon seeds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dried_kelp: Kelp dried in a furnace or smoker. It is a quick snack you can eat very fast. Nine pack into a dried kelp block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pumpkin_seeds: Seeds from a pumpkin. Plant them on farmland with an empty space next to it, where the pumpkin grows. One pumpkin crafts into four seeds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.melon_seeds: Seeds from a melon slice. Plant them on farmland with an empty space next to it, where the melon grows. Villages and jungles sometimes have them in chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beef: Raw beef dropped by cows and mooshrooms. It is edible raw but gives more food cooked. Cook it into steak.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_beef: A cooked steak, one of the most filling foods in the game. Cook raw beef in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Cows killed by fire drop it already cooked.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chicken: Raw chicken dropped by chickens. Eating it raw may give you hunger. Cook it to make it safe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_chicken: A cooked chicken, safe and filling. Cook raw chicken in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is a good everyday food.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rotten_flesh: Decaying meat dropped by zombies. Eating it fills you a little but may give you hunger. Wolves can eat it safely, and clerics buy it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ender_pearl: A pearl dropped by endermen. Throw it to teleport where it lands, taking some damage. Combine it with blaze powder to make an eye of ender.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blaze_rod: A glowing rod dropped by blazes in nether fortresses. It crafts the brewing stand and breaks down into blaze powder. It is also strong fuel.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ghast_tear: A tear dropped by ghasts. It brews potions of regeneration. It is also needed to craft end crystals.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gold_nugget: A small piece of gold from nether gold ore, smelted gold gear or zombified piglins. Nine craft into a gold ingot. It makes golden carrots and glistering melon slices.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_wart: A red fungus that grows on soul sand, found in nether fortresses. It is the base of almost every potion, brewing water into awkward potion. Plant it on soul sand to grow more.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.potion: A drinkable bottle with an effect, brewed at a brewing stand. Start from a water bottle and nether wart, then add ingredients for different effects. Gunpowder makes it a splash potion.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glass_bottle: A bottle made from three glass. Fill it with water, collect honey from a full beehive, or catch dragon's breath. It is the starting point for every potion.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spider_eye: An eye dropped by spiders and witches. Eating it poisons you. It brews potions of poison and makes fermented spider eyes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fermented_spid: A spider eye fermented with sugar and a brown mushroom. In brewing it corrupts potions, turning them into their opposite. It makes potions of weakness, slowness and invisibility.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blaze_powder: Fiery powder made from a blaze rod. It fuels the brewing stand and brews potions of strength. It also makes eyes of ender and fire charges.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magma_cream: A fiery slime dropped by magma cubes, or crafted from a slimeball and blaze powder. It brews potions of fire resistance. Four craft into a magma block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brewing_stand: A stand for brewing potions, made from a blaze rod and three cobblestone. Put up to three bottles below and an ingredient on top. It runs on blaze powder.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cauldron: An iron pot made from seven iron ingots. It holds water, lava or powder snow, and fills slowly in rain or snow. Use the water to wash dye off leather, banners and shulker boxes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ender_eye: An eye made from an ender pearl and blaze powder. Throw it and it flies toward the nearest stronghold, sometimes breaking. Twelve of them in a portal frame open the way to the End.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glistering_mel: A melon slice coated in eight gold nuggets. It can't be eaten. It brews potions of healing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.armadillo_spaw: Spawns an Armadillo when used. Armadillos roll up when threatened and shed scutes used for wolf armor. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.allay_spawn_eg: Spawns an Allay when used. Allays collect items that match the one you hand them. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.axolotl_spawn_: Spawns an Axolotl when used. Axolotls hunt underwater mobs and help you in fights. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bat_spawn_egg: Spawns a Bat when used. Bats flutter around dark caves and are completely harmless. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bee_spawn_egg: Spawns a Bee when used. Bees pollinate flowers and make honey in nests and hives. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blaze_spawn_eg: Spawns a Blaze when used. Blazes guard nether fortresses and shoot fireballs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bogged_spawn_e: Spawns a Bogged when used. The bogged is a swamp skeleton that shoots poison arrows. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.breeze_spawn_e: Spawns a Breeze when used. Breezes live in trial chambers and attack with wind charges. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cat_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cat when used. Cats scare away creepers and phantoms, and you can tame them with fish. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.camel_spawn_eg: Spawns a Camel when used. Camels carry two riders and can dash across the desert. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cave_spider_sp: Spawns a Cave Spider when used. Cave spiders guard mineshafts and poison you with their bite. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chicken_spawn_: Spawns a Chicken when used. Chickens lay eggs and drop feathers and meat. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cod_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cod when used. Cod swim in schools in most oceans. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cow_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cow when used. Cows give milk and drop leather and beef. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.creeper_spawn_: Spawns a Creeper when used. Creepers sneak up on players and explode. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dolphin_spawn_: Spawns a Dolphin when used. Dolphins give swimmers a speed boost and can lead them to treasure. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.donkey_spawn_e: Spawns a Donkey when used. Donkeys can be ridden and can carry a chest. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.drowned_spawn_: Spawns a Drowned when used. Drowned are underwater zombies that sometimes carry tridents. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.elder_guardian: Spawns an Elder Guardian when used. Elder guardians defend ocean monuments and slow down your mining. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ender_dragon_s: Spawns the Ender Dragon when used. The Ender Dragon is the final boss waiting in the End. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.enderman_spawn: Spawns an Enderman when used. Endermen teleport, carry blocks and attack if you look them in the eye. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.endermite_spaw: Spawns an Endermite when used. Endermites sometimes appear where a thrown ender pearl lands. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.evoker_spawn_e: Spawns an Evoker when used. Evokers summon fangs and vexes and drop a totem of undying. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fox_spawn_egg: Spawns a Fox when used. Foxes hunt chickens and rabbits and carry items in their mouths. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.frog_spawn_egg: Spawns a Frog when used. Frogs eat small slimes and magma cubes, leaving froglights behind. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ghast_spawn_eg: Spawns a Ghast when used. Ghasts float over the Nether and shoot exploding fireballs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glow_squid_spa: Spawns a Glow Squid when used. Glow squids light up dark underwater caves and drop glow ink sacs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.goat_spawn_egg: Spawns a Goat when used. Goats ram anything in their way and sometimes drop goat horns. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.guardian_spawn: Spawns a Guardian when used. Guardians defend ocean monuments with laser beams. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hoglin_spawn_e: Spawns a Hoglin when used. Hoglins are aggressive Nether beasts that drop pork and leather. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.horse_spawn_eg: Spawns a Horse when used. Horses are fast mounts that can wear horse armor. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.husk_spawn_egg: Spawns a Husk when used. Husks are desert zombies whose hits make you hungry. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_golem_spa: Spawns an Iron Golem when used. Iron golems protect villages from hostile mobs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.llama_spawn_eg: Spawns a Llama when used. Llamas carry chests and spit at their enemies. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magma_cube_spa: Spawns a Magma Cube when used. Magma cubes bounce around the Nether and split when killed. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mooshroom_spaw: Spawns a Mooshroom when used. Mooshrooms give mushroom stew and drop mushrooms when sheared. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mule_spawn_egg: Spawns a Mule when used. Mules can be ridden and carry a chest, but they can't breed. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ocelot_spawn_e: Spawns an Ocelot when used. Ocelots are shy jungle cats that scare creepers. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.panda_spawn_eg: Spawns a Panda when used. Pandas munch bamboo, and each one has its own personality. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.parrot_spawn_e: Spawns a Parrot when used. Parrots perch on your shoulder and imitate nearby mobs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.phantom_spawn_: Spawns a Phantom when used. Phantoms swoop down on players who haven't slept for days. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pig_spawn_egg: Spawns a Pig when used. Pigs drop porkchops and can be ridden with a saddle. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piglin_spawn_e: Spawns a Piglin when used. Piglins trade items for gold and attack players without gold armor. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piglin_brute_s: Spawns a Piglin Brute when used. Piglin brutes guard bastions and never accept gold. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pillager_spawn: Spawns a Pillager when used. Pillagers are crossbow-wielding raiders from outposts. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polar_bear_spa: Spawns a Polar Bear when used. Polar bears fiercely defend their cubs in snowy biomes. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pufferfish_spa: Spawns a Pufferfish when used. Pufferfish puff up and poison anything nearby. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rabbit_spawn_e: Spawns a Rabbit when used. Rabbits hop around and drop rabbit hide and rabbit's feet. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ravager_spawn_: Spawns a Ravager when used. Ravagers are huge beasts that join raids and trample crops. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.salmon_spawn_e: Spawns a Salmon when used. Salmon swim in rivers and cold oceans. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sheep_spawn_eg: Spawns a Sheep when used. Sheep can be sheared for wool and dyed any color. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.shulker_spawn_: Spawns a Shulker when used. Shulkers hide in End cities and make their targets levitate. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.silverfish_spa: Spawns a Silverfish when used. Silverfish hide in stone and swarm when disturbed. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.skeleton_spawn: Spawns a Skeleton when used. Skeletons shoot arrows and burn in daylight. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.skeleton_horse: Spawns a Skeleton Horse when used. Skeleton horses appear as a trap during thunderstorms. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.slime_spawn_eg: Spawns a Slime when used. Slimes bounce around swamps and split into smaller slimes when killed. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sniffer_spawn_: Spawns a Sniffer when used. Sniffers dig up ancient seeds from the ground. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.snow_golem_spa: Spawns a Snow Golem when used. Snow golems throw snowballs and leave a trail of snow. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spider_spawn_e: Spawns a Spider when used. Spiders climb walls and are only hostile in the dark. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.squid_spawn_eg: Spawns a Squid when used. Squids swim in oceans and drop ink sacs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stray_spawn_eg: Spawns a Stray when used. Strays are icy skeletons whose arrows slow you down. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.strider_spawn_: Spawns a Strider when used. Striders walk across lava and can be ridden with a saddle. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tadpole_spawn_: Spawns a Tadpole when used. Tadpoles grow up into frogs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trader_llama_s: Spawns a Trader Llama when used. Trader llamas follow wandering traders. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tropical_fish_: Spawns a Tropical Fish when used. Tropical fish come in thousands of color patterns. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.turtle_spawn_e: Spawns a Turtle when used. Turtles always return to their home beach to lay eggs. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.vex_spawn_egg: Spawns a Vex when used. Vexes are small flying spirits summoned by evokers. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.villager_spawn: Spawns a Villager when used. Villagers work jobs and trade with players for emeralds. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.vindicator_spa: Spawns a Vindicator when used. Vindicators are axe-wielding illagers from mansions and raids. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wandering_trad: Spawns a Wandering Trader when used. Wandering traders sell rare items from faraway biomes. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warden_spawn_e: Spawns the Warden when used. The Warden is the blind guardian of the deep dark. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.witch_spawn_eg: Spawns a Witch when used. Witches throw harmful potions and drink healing ones. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wither_spawn_e: Spawns the Wither when used. The Wither is a three-headed boss that destroys blocks around it. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wither_skeleto: Spawns a Wither Skeleton when used. Wither skeletons roam nether fortresses and inflict withering. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wolf_spawn_egg: Spawns a Wolf when used. Wolves can be tamed with bones and will fight for you. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zoglin_spawn_e: Spawns a Zoglin when used. Zoglins are zombified hoglins that attack everything. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zombie_spawn_e: Spawns a Zombie when used. Zombies are the classic undead that burn in daylight. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zombie_horse_s: Spawns a Zombie Horse when used. Zombie horses are undead horses. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zombie_village: Spawns a Zombie Villager when used. Zombie villagers can be cured back into villagers. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zombified_pigl: Spawns a Zombified Piglin when used. Zombified piglins are neutral until you attack one of them. Spawn eggs are only available in Creative mode or with commands; using one on a monster spawner changes what it spawns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.experience_bot: A bottle that bursts into experience orbs when thrown. It can't be crafted; clerics sell it, and it appears in some chests. It is handy for repairing gear with Mending.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fire_charge: A fireball made from blaze powder, coal and gunpowder. Use it to light fires like flint and steel, or fire it from a dispenser. Each use consumes one charge.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wind_charge: A burst of wind dropped by breezes. Throw it to knock back mobs, or throw it at your feet to launch yourself into the air. It also flips levers, buttons and doors it hits.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.writable_book: A book you can write in, made from a book, an ink sac and a feather. Write up to a hundred pages. Sign it to turn it into a finished written book.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.written_book: A signed book with a title and author that can no longer be edited. Copy it by crafting it with a book and quill. Place it on a lectern so others can read it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mace: A heavy weapon made from a heavy core and a breeze rod. Its smash attack hits harder the farther you fall before striking. Wind charges and the Wind Burst enchantment let you chain smashes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.item_frame: A frame for displaying items on walls, made from eight sticks and leather. Right-click to put an item in and rotate it. Framed maps show their markers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glow_item_fram: An item frame that makes its item glow even in the dark. Craft an item frame with a glow ink sac. It works just like a normal frame otherwise.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flower_pot: A small pot made from three bricks. Place flowers, saplings, mushrooms, cacti and more inside it. It keeps plants neat on shelves and windowsills.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.carrot: A crunchy vegetable found in villages and sometimes dropped by zombies. Plant it on farmland to grow more. Pigs and rabbits love it, and it makes golden carrots.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.potato: A vegetable grown on farmland, found in villages and sometimes dropped by zombies. Eat it raw or bake it for much more food. Plant it to grow more.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.baked_potato: A potato baked in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is cheap and quite filling. Farmers can grow lots of them easily.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.poisonous_pota: A green potato that rarely appears when harvesting potatoes. Eating it may poison you. Compost it instead.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.map: A blank map made from eight paper around a compass. Use it to create a map of the area around you. Cartographers sell maps to special structures.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_carrot: A carrot wrapped in eight gold nuggets. It is one of the best foods for saturation. It brews potions of night vision and can be fed to horses.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.skeleton_skull: A skull dropped by skeletons killed by a charged creeper's explosion. Wear it, place it as decoration, or put it on a note block to play skeleton sounds. Wearing it makes skeletons notice you less.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.wither_skeleto: A rare skull dropped by wither skeletons. Three on top of four soul sand or soul soil in a T shape summon the Wither. It can also be worn or placed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.player_head: A head showing a player's skin. It can only be obtained with commands. It makes a fun decoration.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.zombie_head: A head dropped by zombies killed by a charged creeper. Wear it, or place it as decoration. Wearing it makes zombies notice you less.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.creeper_head: A head dropped by creepers killed by a charged creeper. Wear it to make creepers notice you less. On a banner it adds a creeper face pattern.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dragon_head: A head found on the bows of End ships. Powered by redstone, its mouth opens and closes. Wear it or place it as a striking decoration.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piglin_head: A head dropped by piglins killed by a charged creeper. Its ears flap when powered by redstone. Wearing it makes piglins notice you less.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_star: A star dropped by the Wither when defeated. It is needed to craft a beacon. It can't be destroyed by explosions.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pumpkin_pie: A pie baked from a pumpkin, sugar and an egg. It restores plenty of hunger. It is a good way to use spare pumpkins.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.firework_rocke: A rocket made from paper and gunpowder, with optional firework stars. Launch it for a show, or use it while gliding with elytra to fly faster. Crossbows can fire them too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.firework_star: A star made from gunpowder and dye that sets the colors and shape of a firework. Add extras like glowstone dust for twinkle or a diamond for a trail. Craft it into a firework rocket.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.enchanted_book: A book holding an enchantment. Combine it with an item on an anvil to apply its enchantment. Get it from enchanting books, trading with librarians or looting chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nether_brick: A small dark brick made by smelting netherrack. Four craft into a nether brick block. It is also needed for nether brick fences.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_sha: A shard dropped by guardians and elder guardians. It crafts into prismarine, prismarine bricks and dark prismarine. It is part of the sea lantern and conduit recipes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_cry: Glowing crystals dropped by guardians and sea lanterns. Together with prismarine shards they craft sea lanterns. They can't be made any other way.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rabbit: Raw rabbit meat dropped by rabbits. It is edible raw, but cooking it makes it better. It is the base of rabbit stew.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_rabbit: Cooked rabbit meat. Cook raw rabbit in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It goes into rabbit stew.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rabbit_stew: A hearty stew of cooked rabbit, a carrot, a baked potato and a mushroom in a bowl. It is one of the most filling foods. You keep the bowl after eating.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rabbit_foot: A lucky charm rarely dropped by rabbits. It brews potions of leaping. Clerics buy it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rabbit_hide: A small hide dropped by rabbits. Four craft into leather. It is also used for bundles.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.armor_stand: A stand for displaying armor and heads. Craft it from six sticks and a smooth stone slab. Its pose changes when powered by redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_horse_arm: Iron armor for horses that can't be crafted. Find it in dungeon, desert pyramid and other chests. It gives a horse moderate protection.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.golden_horse_a: Gold armor for horses that can't be crafted. Find it in chests around the world. It protects a little better than leather but less than iron.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.diamond_horse_: Diamond armor for horses, the strongest horse protection. It can't be crafted and is found in chests. Equip it in a horse's armor slot.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.leather_horse_: Leather armor for horses, crafted from seven leather. It gives a little protection. You can dye it any color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lead: A rope for leading animals and other mobs around. Craft four string and a slimeball into two leads. Tie it to a fence post to keep a mob in place.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.name_tag: A tag for naming a mob. Rename it at an anvil, then use it on a mob; named mobs never despawn. Find it in chests, by fishing or from librarians.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.command_block_: A minecart carrying a command block that runs its command when it passes over a powered activator rail. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it for moving effects.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mutton: Raw mutton dropped by sheep. It is edible raw but better cooked. Cook it into cooked mutton.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cooked_mutton: Cooked mutton, a good everyday food. Cook raw mutton in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Sheep killed by fire drop it already cooked.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_banner: A white banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six white wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_banner: A orange banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six orange wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_banner: A magenta banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six magenta wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_ban: A light blue banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six light blue wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_banner: A yellow banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six yellow wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_banner: A lime banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six lime wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_banner: A pink banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six pink wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_banner: A gray banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six gray wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_ban: A light gray banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six light gray wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cyan_banner: A cyan banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six cyan wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purple_banner: A purple banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six purple wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_banner: A blue banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six blue wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_banner: A brown banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six brown wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_banner: A green banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six green wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_banner: A red banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six red wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.black_banner: A black banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six black wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.end_crystal: A crystal made from glass, an eye of ender and a ghast tear. On the End's pillars they heal the dragon; four on the exit portal summon it again. It explodes violently when hit.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chorus_fruit: A fruit from chorus plants in the End. Eating it teleports you to a random nearby spot. Smelt it into popped chorus fruit.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.popped_chorus_: Chorus fruit cooked in a furnace. It can't be eaten. It crafts into purpur blocks and end rods.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.torchflower_se: Ancient seeds that sniffers dig up. Plant them on farmland to grow a torchflower. Sniffers breed with them.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pitcher_pod: An ancient seed pod that sniffers dig up. Plant it on farmland to grow a tall pitcher plant. It takes a few stages to bloom.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beetroot: A red root vegetable grown from beetroot seeds. It gives a little food and makes red dye. Six with a bowl make beetroot soup.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beetroot_seeds: Seeds for growing beetroots, found in villages and dungeon chests. Plant them on farmland. Chickens can be bred with them.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beetroot_soup: A bowl of soup made from six beetroots. It is fairly filling. You keep the bowl after eating.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dragon_breath: Purple breath collected in a glass bottle from the Ender Dragon's attack. It turns splash potions into lingering potions. Collect it while the dragon breathes on the portal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.splash_potion: A potion you throw, splashing its effect on everything nearby. Brew it by adding gunpowder to a regular potion. Splash potions of weakness help cure zombie villagers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spectral_arrow: An arrow that makes its target glow, visible through walls. Craft four glowstone dust around an arrow for two. It is great for tracking mobs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tipped_arrow: An arrow carrying a potion effect. Craft eight arrows around a lingering potion. The effect lasts a shorter time than drinking the potion.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lingering_poti: A thrown potion that leaves a cloud of its effect on the ground. Brew it by adding dragon's breath to a splash potion. It makes tipped arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.shield: A shield made from six planks and an iron ingot. Hold right-click to block attacks and arrows. Combine it with a banner to decorate it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.totem_of_undyi: A totem dropped by evokers. Hold it in either hand and it saves you from death once, restoring some health and giving useful effects. It is used up when it activates.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.shulker_shell: A shell dropped by shulkers in End cities. Two shells and a chest make a shulker box. It is the only way to craft one.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_nugget: A small piece of iron from smelting iron tools and armor. Nine craft into an iron ingot. It makes lanterns and chains.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.knowledge_book: A book that teaches you crafting recipes when used. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it to unlock recipes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.debug_stick: A tool that changes block states, like the direction of stairs or the age of crops. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it to fine-tune builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_13: A music disc with "13" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it, and it turns up in dungeon chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_cat: A music disc with "cat" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it, and it turns up in dungeon chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_blo: A music disc with "blocks" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_chi: A music disc with "chirp" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_cre: A music disc with "Creator" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is a rare reward from ominous vaults in trial chambers.
A music disc with "Creator (Music Box)" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found in decorated pots inside trial chambers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_far: A music disc with "far" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_mal: A music disc with "mall" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_mel: A music disc with "mellohi" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_sta: A music disc with "stal" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_str: A music disc with "strad" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_war: A music disc with "ward" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_11: A music disc with "11" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. This eerie, broken-sounding track is dropped by creepers killed by a skeleton.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_wai: A music disc with "wait" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_oth: A music disc with "otherside" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found in dungeon and stronghold chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_rel: A music disc with "Relic" by Aaron Cherof. Play it in a jukebox. It is dug up from suspicious gravel in trail ruins.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_5: A music disc with "5" by Samuel Åberg. Play it in a jukebox. It is crafted from nine disc fragments found in ancient cities.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_pig: A music disc with "Pigstep" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found only in bastion remnant chests.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.music_disc_pre: A music disc with "Precipice" by Aaron Cherof. Play it in a jukebox. It is a reward from vaults in trial chambers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.disc_fragment_: A piece of a broken music disc found in ancient city chests. Nine fragments craft into music disc 5. Find them all to hear the eerie track.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trident: A three-pronged weapon dropped by drowned. Throw it at targets or use it in melee. It can be enchanted with Loyalty, Riptide or Channeling.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.phantom_membra: A membrane dropped by phantoms. It repairs elytra at an anvil. It brews potions of slow falling.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.nautilus_shell: A shell held by some drowned, caught by fishing or sold by wandering traders. Eight of them and a heart of the sea craft a conduit. It has no other use.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.heart_of_the_s: A rare treasure found in buried treasure chests. Craft it with eight nautilus shells into a conduit. Treasure maps from shipwrecks and ocean ruins lead to it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crossbow: A ranged weapon that stays loaded until you fire it. Craft it from sticks, string, an iron ingot and a tripwire hook. It can also shoot firework rockets.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.suspicious_ste: A stew of a red mushroom, a brown mushroom and a flower in a bowl. Eating it gives a short effect that depends on the flower. Brown mooshrooms give one when fed a flower and milked with a bowl.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.loom: A workstation for adding patterns to banners. Craft it from two string and two planks. It is the job site of shepherds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flower_banner_: A banner pattern that adds the "Flower Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and an oxeye daisy. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.creeper_banner: A banner pattern that adds the "Creeper Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and a creeper head. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.skull_banner_p: A banner pattern that adds the "Skull Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and a wither skeleton skull. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mojang_banner_: A banner pattern that adds the "Thing" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and an enchanted golden apple. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.globe_banner_p: A banner pattern that adds the "Globe" design at a loom. Buy it from master cartographers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piglin_banner_: A banner pattern that adds the "Snout" design at a loom. Find it in bastion remnant chests. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.flow_banner_pa: A banner pattern that adds the "Flow" design at a loom. Find it in ominous vaults in trial chambers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.guster_banner_: A banner pattern that adds the "Guster" design at a loom. Find it in vaults in trial chambers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.goat_horn: A horn dropped when a goat rams something solid. Use it to play a loud call that can be heard far away. They also turn up in pillager outposts.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.composter: A bin made from seven wooden slabs. Fill it with plants and food to turn them into bone meal. It is the job site of farmers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.barrel: A storage block with 27 slots, crafted from six planks and two wooden slabs. Unlike a chest, it opens even with a block on top. It is the job site of fishermen.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smoker: A furnace that cooks food twice as fast, but only food. Craft it from a furnace and four logs. It is the job site of butchers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blast_furnace: A furnace that smelts ores and metal gear twice as fast, but not food. Craft it from a furnace, iron ingots and smooth stone. It is the job site of armorers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cartography_ta: A table for copying, zooming and locking maps. Craft it from two paper and four planks. It is the job site of cartographers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.fletching_tabl: A table made from two flint and four planks. It has no use for players yet. It is the job site of fletchers.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.grindstone: A workstation that repairs items and strips their enchantments, giving back some experience. Craft it from sticks, a stone slab and planks. It is the job site of weaponsmiths.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.smithing_table: A table for upgrading diamond gear to netherite and adding armor trims. Craft it from two iron ingots and four planks. It is the job site of toolsmiths.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stonecutter: A saw that cuts stone blocks into stairs, slabs, walls and more, often more efficiently than crafting. Craft it from three stone and an iron ingot. It is the job site of masons.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bell: A golden bell found in village centres. Ringing it gathers villagers inside and makes nearby raiders glow. It can't be crafted.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lantern: A hanging lantern made from a torch and eight iron nuggets. It gives as much light as a torch and can hang from chains or sit on blocks. It works great for cosy lighting.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.soul_lantern: A lantern with a blue soul flame, made from a soul torch and iron nuggets. It is dimmer than a regular lantern. Piglins avoid soul fire.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sweet_berries: Berries from sweet berry bushes in taigas. Eat them for a little food or plant them to grow a bush. The bushes scratch anything walking through, and foxes love them.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.glow_berries: Glowing berries from cave vines in lush caves. Eat them for a little food. Plant them on the underside of a block to grow cave vines.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.campfire: A campfire that cooks up to four items without fuel. Its smoke rises high, even higher over a hay bale. Without Silk Touch it drops charcoal; craft it from sticks, logs and coal.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.soul_campfire: A campfire with a blue soul flame, made with soul sand or soul soil. It deals more damage than a regular campfire and cooks food just as well. Piglins avoid it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.shroomlight: A glowing block found in the caps of huge nether fungi. It gives off full light. It is a warm-looking light source.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.honeycomb: Wax collected with shears from a full bee nest or beehive. It waxes copper to stop oxidation and crafts candles and beehives. Put a campfire under the nest first to calm the bees.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bee_nest: A natural home for bees, found on trees. When full of honey, collect honeycomb with shears or honey with a bottle. Mine it with Silk Touch to move it with the bees inside.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.beehive: A crafted home for bees, made from planks and three honeycomb. Bees fill it with honey as they pollinate flowers. Harvest honeycomb with shears or honey with a bottle.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.honey_bottle: A bottle of honey from a full bee nest or beehive. Drinking it cures poison. Four make a honey block, and one makes three sugar.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.honeycomb_bloc: A block of four honeycomb. It is purely decorative. It suits bee-themed builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lodestone: A block that makes a compass point to it when the compass is used on it. Craft it from chiseled stone bricks and an iron ingot. It works even across long distances in the same dimension.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crying_obsidia: Obsidian that weeps purple tears, found in ruined portals and bastions. It can't light a Nether portal. It is needed to craft a respawn anchor.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blackstone: A dark stone found in basalt deltas and bastion remnants. It works like cobblestone for stone tools and furnaces. Polish it for a smoother look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blackstone_sla: Half a block of blackstone. Craft three blackstone in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. It suits dark, Nether-style builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blackstone_sta: Stairs made of blackstone. Craft six blackstone in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They suit dark, Nether-style builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gilded_blackst: Blackstone flecked with gold, found in bastion remnants. Mining it sometimes drops gold nuggets instead. Piglins get angry if they see you break it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: Blackstone polished into a smooth, dark block. Craft four blackstone into four, or use a stonecutter. It makes buttons, pressure plates and bricks.
Half a block of polished blackstone. Craft three in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. Two slabs in one space make a full block.
Stairs made of polished blackstone. Craft six in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They give a clean, dark step.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_polis: Polished blackstone carved with a piglin face. Craft two polished blackstone slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It is found in bastion remnants.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: Dark bricks made from polished blackstone, the main block of bastions. Craft four polished blackstone into four, or use a stonecutter. Smelt them for a cracked version.
Half a block of polished blackstone bricks. Craft three in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. It suits bastion-style builds.
Stairs made of polished blackstone bricks. Craft six in a stair shape for four, or use a stonecutter. They suit bastion-style builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cracked_polish: Polished blackstone bricks with cracks across them. Smelt polished blackstone bricks to make them. They give builds a ruined look.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.respawn_anchor: A block that lets you set your respawn point in the Nether. Charge it with glowstone and use it to set your spawn; each respawn uses a charge. Used outside the Nether, it explodes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.candle: A plain candle made from string and honeycomb. Light it with flint and steel; up to four fit in one block. Dye it to change its color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.white_candle: A white candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and white dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.orange_candle: A orange candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and orange dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.magenta_candle: A magenta candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and magenta dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_blue_can: A light blue candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and light blue dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.yellow_candle: A yellow candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and yellow dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lime_candle: A lime candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and lime dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pink_candle: A pink candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and pink dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.gray_candle: A gray candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and gray dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_gray_can: A light gray candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and light gray dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cyan_candle: A cyan candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and cyan dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.purple_candle: A purple candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and purple dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.blue_candle: A blue candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and blue dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brown_candle: A brown candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and brown dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.green_candle: A green candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and green dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_candle: A red candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and red dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.black_candle: A black candle lit with flint and steel. Up to four fit in one block, and one on a cake makes a candle cake. Craft it from a candle and black dye.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.small_amethyst: The first stage of an amethyst crystal growing on budding amethyst. It slowly grows bigger. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.medium_amethys: The second stage of an amethyst crystal. It keeps growing into a large bud. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.large_amethyst: The third stage of an amethyst crystal, almost fully grown. It soon becomes a cluster. Without Silk Touch it drops nothing.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.amethyst_clust: A fully grown amethyst crystal. Mine it with a pickaxe for four amethyst shards, or more with Fortune. It glows faintly and chimes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pointed_dripst: A sharp spike of dripstone that hangs from ceilings or rises from floors. Falling onto it hurts more, and spikes overhead fall when broken. Dripping water or lava from it can fill a cauldron below.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ochre_frogligh: A glowing block made when a temperate (orange) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a warm yellow color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.verdant_frogli: A glowing block made when a cold (green) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a soft green color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.pearlescent_fr: A glowing block made when a warm (white) frog eats a small magma cube. It gives off full light. It has a pale pink-purple color.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.frogspawn: Eggs laid by frogs on water. They hatch into tadpoles after a while. They can't be picked up.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.echo_shard: A mysterious shard found only in ancient city chests. Eight of them around a compass craft a recovery compass. It has no other use yet.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.brush: A tool for archaeology made from a feather, a copper ingot and a stick. Brush suspicious sand and gravel to uncover buried items. It also collects scutes from armadillos.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_grate: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_copper: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It has started to oxidize and keeps aging unless waxed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_copp: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_coppe: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_copper_g: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax at the first stage of oxidation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax in its mostly green stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: A see-through copper grid that lets light and water through. Craft four copper blocks into four grates, or use a stonecutter. It is sealed with wax in its fully teal stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_bulb: A copper lamp that switches on or off with each redstone pulse, giving off full light. Craft three copper blocks, a blaze rod and redstone into four. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trial_spawner: A spawner in trial chambers that releases waves of mobs when players come near. Defeating them rewards trial keys and loot. It can't be obtained.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trial_key: A key dropped by trial spawners when you beat their mobs. Use it to open a vault in trial chambers. Each vault opens once per player.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ominous_trial_: A key dropped by ominous trial spawners. Use it to open an ominous vault, which holds better rewards like the heavy core. Each vault opens once per player.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.vault: A locked treasure box in trial chambers. Unlock it with a trial key to receive loot; it remembers who opened it. It can't be obtained.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.ominous_bottle: A bottle dropped by raid captains. Drinking it gives Bad Omen, which turns trial chambers ominous or starts a raid in a village. Its level sets how strong the effect is.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.breeze_rod: A rod dropped by breezes in trial chambers. It crafts into four wind charges. Combined with a heavy core it makes the mace.
